Getting started

Lumen runs in your browser and on your desktop. This guide installs the command line tool, creates a notebook and links your first two notes. See installation for other systems.

Install the tool

Install with your package manager, then run lumen init in an empty folder:

npm install -g lumen-cli
lumen init my-notes
cd my-notes && lumen open
NoteThe first run downloads about 40 MB of language data. Later runs start at once.

Link two notes

  1. Open any note and type two square brackets.
  2. Pick the note to link from the list.
  3. Press Enter to insert the link.

Links work both ways: the other note lists this one under Mentioned in.

  • Backlinks update as you type.
  • Renaming a note keeps its links.
  • Deleted notes leave a marker.
